treatmentTypes.title: Types of Broken Tooth Treatments Available Near You

items.title: Dental Bonding
items.description: Minor chips and small fractures can often be repaired using tooth-colored composite resin that blends naturally with your teeth.

items.title: Dental Filling
items.description: If the break is caused by decay, a tooth-colored filling may restore the tooth's shape and function.

items.title: Dental Crown
items.description: For larger fractures, a custom-made crown covers and strengthens the damaged tooth while restoring its appearance.

items.title: Root Canal with Crown
items.description: If the tooth's nerve has been exposed or infected, root canal treatment followed by a dental crown may be recommended.

items.title: Tooth Extraction & Replacement
items.description: If a tooth is severely damaged beyond repair, extraction may be necessary. We also offer options such as dental implants or bridges to replace missing teeth.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Broken Tooth Treatment Near Me

items.question: How soon should I see a dentist after breaking a tooth?
items.answer: You should visit a dentist as soon as possible. Early treatment helps prevent infection and increases the chances of saving the tooth.

items.question: Can a broken tooth be repaired?
items.answer: Yes. Many broken teeth can be restored using bonding, fillings, crowns, or other restorative treatments depending on the extent of damage.

items.question: Is broken tooth treatment painful?
items.answer: Modern dental procedures are performed using local anesthesia, making treatment comfortable for most patients.

items.question: Will I need a crown for a broken tooth?
items.answer: A dental crown is recommended when the tooth has significant structural damage and requires additional strength and protection.

items.question: What happens if I leave a broken tooth untreated?
items.answer: Ignoring a broken tooth can lead to worsening cracks, infection, severe pain, nerve damage, or even tooth loss.

items.question: How much does broken tooth treatment cost in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the severity of the damage and the treatment required. A consultation allows us to provide an accurate estimate.
